group_assessment.weighting: PubMed ESearch 2026-10-02: Gabra H[au] 180 records, 7 intersecting WWOX. A gynaecological-oncology translational group with a standing WWOX line in ovarian cancer (the PEO1 WWOX transfectants are their own, from a prior paper). Competent in the cell biology and in the microarray survival analysis; no neurological or developmental WWOX work. The paper was edited by R Aqeilan, which is declared in the deposit.

queries.query: WWOX AND (endoplasmic reticulum stress OR unfolded protein response)

field_density.note: Only two records intersect WWOX with ER stress or the UPR. This is effectively the sole primary source for a WWOX-UPR link, so nothing in the literature replicates or contradicts it independently.

multihop.enumeration_method: All 52 references enumerated from the JATS deposit. The deposit carries no pub-id/pmid element on the reference list, so no gene-direct reference can be addressed by PMID from this artefact alone; declared empty rather than padded. The dependency screen below covers the same list by DOI and returns SCREENED_CLEAN.

corpus_crossquery.note: CORPUS-STUB-126 and LIT-0145 are identity records and both are stubs ('not yet extracted', 'not yet screened'); DL-MECH-023 already states the WWOX-orients-UPR lead from this paper. This reading adds that Figures 5c-5e carry no statistics and that the KIRA6 increment is the same in both genotypes, which is what the lead's inferential step rests on.

entries.proposition: The gain-of-function host line is a human WWOX-null by homozygous deletion of exons 4 to 8, so this is restoration into a null background rather than overexpression above normal.
entries.snippet: is homozygously deleted for WWOX exons 4
entries.anchor: Materials and methods, Cell lines (sentence continues 'to 8 and lacks WWOX protein expression')

entries.proposition: Restoring WWOX increases death under stress and removing it increases survival; the rescued state in this system is greater apoptotic sensitivity.
entries.snippet: whereas WWOX siRNA knockdown increased survival
entries.anchor: Results, Paclitaxel induces ER stress response and WWOX determines cell fate in response to prolonged ER stress, para 1

entries.proposition: The paper states that PERK activation itself is unaffected by WWOX status, which narrows the WWOX-UPR link to the IRE-1 arm within this paper's own data.
entries.snippet: No changes in activation of PERK were observed as a result of WWOX status
entries.anchor: Results, Paclitaxel induces ER stress response and WWOX determines cell fate in response to prolonged ER stress, para 2

entries.proposition: The claimed WWOX-dependence of the IRE-1 inhibitor effect is asserted in the prose as a blunting of the inhibitor's effect in WWOX-absent cells.
entries.snippet: cells were less sensitive to KIRA6 and GSK2656157 as shown by the blunted effects on cell viability
entries.anchor: Results, Paclitaxel induces ER stress response and WWOX determines cell fate in response to prolonged ER stress, para 3

entries.proposition: The panel cited for that claim carries no significance marker and no P-value anywhere, and the absolute viability increment produced by KIRA6 is the same in the WWOX-expressing and the WWOX-null clone, so the blunting is a fold-change artefact of the lower baseline.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5 panels c, d and e carry grouped bars with error bars and no asterisk, bracket or P-value of any kind. In panel c (PEO1, 8 nM paclitaxel) the WWOX-8 bars read about 0.05 for paclitaxel alone and about 0.24 for paclitaxel plus KIRA6, while the Vector-9 bars read about 0.13 and about 0.31 - an increment of about 0.19 against about 0.18.
entries.anchor: Figure 5, panels c-e; native JPEG inspected

entries.proposition: The prose asserts that the present-versus-absent WWOX dichotomisation shows longer PFS in taxane-treated patients.
entries.snippet: this dichotomisation suggests longer PFS in patients with WWOX expression detectable at a level comparable to normal tissue
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX expression and PFS, final sentence

entries.proposition: A PFS panel reported in the prose as showing an effect is printed with a non-significant P-value.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 7 panel e is titled 'PFS by WWOX expression relative to normal, TCGA with Tax' and prints 'n=333, p=0.13' in its header.
entries.anchor: Figure 7, panel e; native JPEG inspected
entries.contradicts_needle: suggests longer PFS in patients with WWOX expression detectable

entries.proposition: The taxane-specificity of the survival association rests on nulls in very small subgroups rather than on a demonstrated interaction.
entries.snippet: the association between WWOX expression and OS was lost (TCGA n=33, hazard ratio=1.9, P=0.64; Tothill n=48, hazard ratio=1.0, P=0.98)

entries.proposition: The only statement this paper makes about the nervous system is a one-sentence expression and phenotype citation in the Introduction; nothing neural is measured.
entries.snippet: also in neuronal bodies throughout the central nervous system
